args.request: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

story.title: Café reel
story.setting: A cosy neighbourhood café with warm natural daylight, wood furniture and plants, soft realistic photographic look.

subjects.words: The café storefront with a navy and cream striped awning and small wooden tables outside.
A latte with leaf latte art and a small green leaf in a white cup on a round marble table.
Golden croissants on trays in a glass display case.
A dark-haired barista in a black t-shirt at an espresso machine.
The café interior with hanging lamps, plants, wooden tables and guests.

beats.text: Slow gentle push-in on the café storefront.
Slow drift over the latte on the marble table, a wisp of steam rising.
Slow glide along the croissants in the display case.
The barista calmly pours steamed milk into a cup.
Slow gentle pull-back across the café interior as guests chat.

story.music: relaxed instrumental café music, soft acoustic guitar and light piano
